reason: My bank app already shows my transaction history, and I only check my spending once a month anyway. I don't want to pay for a second place to track the same money, and I'd have to set up an iPhone Shortcut just to get it started.
objection: Why would I pay 69 baht to copy numbers my bank already has? If the trial ends and I forget to cancel, I'm charged for something I stopped using.
would_change_my_mind: If the app pulled my spending from the bank and card statements by itself, with no setup and no screenshots, and showed me something my bank app doesn't, like the needs/savings/wants split.
